title: Integrated go-to-market timeline and cut-matrix for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: produce a single integrated timeline, a deterministic scope-lock date, and a concrete cut/exception matrix that operations, engineering, docs, design, and GTM use to coordinate launch activities across API, Console, and Runtime. This ticket consolidates inputs from eng reliability, runtime performance, console UX, and GTM enablement and produces: (1) milestone calendar for feature gates and cut decisions, (2) a cut-matrix mapping severity/impact to allowed scope exceptions, and (3) a coordinated release-notes and comms windows schedule. The output will be an actionable plan that PMs and engineering leads can follow during the next release train. Key constraints: latency SLOs must remain met for dedicated customers; rollout windows must preserve canary/backout capability; docs and support must have final assets at least 5 business days before public notice.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone calendar published to Confluence with owners and dates
Scope-lock (final feature list + exceptions) agreed by cross-functional steering group by 2025-02-24
Cut-matrix documented showing what categories of work can be dropped and the approval path for exceptions
Release notes draft and customer-facing messaging windows scheduled; docs/stable changelog entries linked
Rollout/rollback playbook validated with SRE and QA and linked to the incident runbook
All dependent engineering PRs and console UI PRs have target merge-by dates in the calendar

rollout_plan: Canary -> Staggered regional rollout -> Global switch. Canary window (2h) in primary region, extended metrics review (4h) before 10% traffic ramp, then 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 48 hours if all KPIs green. Emergency backout path: abort ramp and revert to previous model variant + traffic split to fallback region. Communication: internal incident channel + ops pager escalation on KPI breach. Sales/CS notified at 30% if no regressions.
cut_criteria_matrix: Severity A (blocks SLOs or security): immediate cut, require Eng Director + SRE sign-off to re-introduce. Severity B (degrades performance >5% at p95 for >1hr): eligible for cut if alternative mitigation exists; requires engineering lead + PM approval. Severity C (minor UI polish, non-blocking docs): cuttable by PM without exec sign-off. Emergency exceptions allowed with written justification and approval chain recorded in the steering group notes.
post_mortem_plan: If we fail to meet rollout KPIs or have a customer-impacting incident, conduct a blameless postmortem within 72 hours, publish RCA and remediation ticket list, and hold a cross-functional retro. Ownership: SRE for RCA, PM for communication and tracking remediation tickets.
